where: How My Own Model Could Become a Cult, P3

where: How My Own Model Could Become a Cult, P6
his: There is also a floor the majority cannot vote away: bodily safety, enough food and sleep, independent medical care, private thought, contact with people outside the community, a way to report harm without asking the accused person’s friends for permission, and a usable way to leave. why: Drops his published list of protected rights (food, sleep, medical care, private thought, reporting harm, leaving) and the majority-vote line.

where: Leaving Voluntarily, P1
his: A money-free community still has scarce things and bottlenecks.
